item.title: Snapchat's new 'AI Clips' Lens format turns photos into five-second videos | TechCrunch
item.description: Snapchat says both experienced and new developers can use the new "AI Clips" Lens format to turn a single prompt into a published Lens in minutes without the need for external tools.

item.title: Zoox brings its robotaxis to Austin and Miami | TechCrunch
item.description: After nearly two years of testing in the two cities, the Amazon-owned company says it's getting closer to offering rides.

item.title: Exclusive: Cauldron Ferm has turned microbes into nonstop assembly lines | TechCrunch
item.description: The Australian startup says it has solved one of the biggest challenges facing synthetic biology companies, which it counts as customers.

item.title: Pinterest launches a new feature to promote a Pin | TechCrunch
item.description: Pinterest is rolling out promoted pin feature to the users in the U.S. in coming weeks

item.title: FCC bans import of new consumer routers made overseas, citing security risks | TechCrunch
item.description: The FCC ban will affect the import of all new, foreign-made consumer routers, the agency's head Brendan Carr said.

item.title: After pivoting, Y Combinator grad Glimpse raises $35M led by a16z | TechCrunch
item.description: Glimpse announced on Wednesday a $35 million Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from 8VC and YC.

item.title: Elon Musk pauses changes to X's creator revenue-sharing program after backlash | TechCrunch
item.description: Hours after announcement of the new policy Elon Musk said X is pausing the rollout.

item.title: Sony and Honda give up on their joint EV project | TechCrunch
item.description: The Sony-Honda joint venture has killed plans for its Afeela sedan and SUV electric vehicles. The news comes shortly after Honda reversed its plans to launch more electric vehicles in the U.S.

item.title: Meta turns to AI to make shopping easier on Instagram and Facebook | TechCrunch
item.description: Meta is using generative AI to provide more product and brand information to consumers when they're shopping in its apps.

item.title: Arbor Energy just landed a billion-dollar order to bring rocket turbine tech to the power grid | TechCrunch
item.description: The large deal sees Arbor delivering as many as 200 of its Halcyon turbines, which can burn either natural gas or waste biomass.

item.title: Meta launches new initiative to support entrepreneurship, drive AI adoption | TechCrunch
item.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said in a memo to staff that small businesses have always been a big part of the company's business model, and that while tens of millions of entrepreneurs already use its platforms to grow and connect with customers, the company wants to do more in the space.

item.title: Granola raises $125M, hits $1.5B valuation as it expands from meeting notetaker to enterprise AI app | TechCrunch
item.description: Granola's valuation jumped from $250 million to $1.5 billion with this round, and it has added more support for AI agents after users previously complained.

item.title: Harvey confirms $11B valuation: Sequoia triples down | TechCrunch
item.description: Investors like Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, Elad Gil can't get enough of AI legal tech startup Harvey.

item.title: How soap opera-TikTok hybrids became a billion-dollar business | TechCrunch
item.description: Watch as Equity digs into the short-form, mobile-first shows quietly becoming a multi-billion dollar industry, with Watch Club founder Henry Soong.

item.title: Reddit takes on the bots with new 'human verification' requirements for fishy behavior | TechCrunch
item.description: Reddit will require suspected automated accounts to verify they’re human, as it ramps up efforts to curb bot-driven spam and manipulation.
